answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a multi-turn ESC system MultiESC to address the above issues.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the generation quality, we adopt the following metrics: perplexity (PPL), BLEU-1/2/3/4 (B-1/2/3/4), ROUGE-L (R-L), METEOR (MET).

answer_4.quote: We recruit four graduate students with linguistic or psychological background as annotators to chat with the models for human interactive evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are asked to choose which one performs better (or select tie) in terms of the following metrics: (1) Fluency: which model generates more fluent and understandable responses; (2) Empathy: which model has more appropriate emotion reactions, such as warmth, compassion and concern; (3) Identification: which model explores the user's situation more effectively to identify the problem; (4) Suggestion: which model offers more helpful suggestions; (5) Overall: which model provides more effective emotional support overall.
